# ANALYSIS: Baseline Engine Walk-Forward Test and Real-Fills Validation for 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q1

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are evaluating the baseline engine (no changes) over the walk-forward period 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q1 and validating real-fills on the three J winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) to establish the baseline performance for OP-16 scoring. This serves as the control for comparing future strategy changes.

## Mechanism

No changes to the engine. We run the baseline engine's logic on historical data for the period 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q1 (walk-forward) and check the real-fills on the three J winner days (which fall outside this window, in 2026-Q2).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Baseline engine uses current `params.json` (Safe) with dual-account rules. Assumes $2K+ account for position sizing (3 contracts at $1K-$2K tier).  
2. **Sample bias:** Walk-forward period 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q1 (3 quarters). Selection is time-based. Overfit risk exists but mitigated by walk-forward design; actual risk unknown without test.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward test for 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q1 is OOS relative to leaderboard's training period, which is unspecified).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (validation on three J winner days pending; J loser days also need validation).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: potential loss on 5/05/5/06/5/07 exceeding J-day losses; max drawdown unknown; blow-up scenario: consecutive losers exceeding daily risk cap.  
6. **Concentration:** Unknown without walk-forward results (top-5 days % of P&L requires P&L distribution over 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q1).  

## Pre-merge gate

- Walk-forward test on baseline engine for 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q1 must pass:  
  - WF ratio ≥ 0.70  
  - Positive OOS P&L  
  - Stable performance across sub-windows (no more than 1 negative quarter)  
- Real-fills validation on three J winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) must show engine captures ≥90% of expected P&L ($342, $470, $730)  
- Gym validators: 100% pass rate on existing test suite  

## Confidence

2 / 10 -- No data available for walk-forward period or J loser days. Baseline edge_capture on J winners is inferred from leaderboard but not independently verified for this window. High uncertainty due to missing backtest.

This analysis provides baseline context for all candidates. No conflict; complements leaderboard by highlighting missing validation data needed to assess proposed changes against OP-16 anchors.
